article.body:
### UK MAA table lists proposed aviation regulation changes

The Ministry of Defence’s Military Aviation Authority (MAA) NPA reference table is described as listing proposed regulatory changes and release dates. These are proposals, not evidence that amendments have been approved or brought into force. The available source text does not establish which organisations are affected or whether any proposed change has been adopted.
